title: Aspiring writer-director here. I’ve got a question.

commenti.body:
1. 5/10
2. 6/10
3. 8/10

The third one about the poetry world sounds the coolest to me if it’s executed well, since poetry allows for all kinds of cool imagery and metaphors, resulting in potentially some tense or emotional scenes.

The first one doesn’t seem to have that much potential and I would worry it’d come across as ableist if not handled carefully.

The second one is kind of cool but too B-movie for me to have much faith in it being actually good.

You’ve asked this same question before, haven’t you? The real answer isn’t which concept is best but which one you like the most and find the most worthy of fleshing out to feature length and/or making a polished short version of to prove your concept. 

Have you made a look book or a rip-o-matic for any of these? Or story boards?

What about a treatment? 

You’re overthinking and under-making.

It’s time to just go with your gut, follow your bliss and start making something — even if it’s just a part of one of these films or a draft of one of these scripts.

Otherwise you’ll keep just dreaming about these and posting things like this again. And that reminds me a little of the joke about pitching movie concepts in “Annie Hall”: ine: "Right now it's only a notion, but I think I can get money to make it into a concept ... and later maybe even turn it into an idea."
